narrative.intro: Veterans Evaluation Services obligated $97.4M in FY27 to date through five awards, with an average award size of $19.5M. Obligations fell 94.1% year over year. Veterans Evaluation Services recorded larger annual obligations in prior years, including $691M in FY22, $693M in FY23, $1.1B in FY24, $2B in FY25, and $1.7B in FY26. The current-year total is partial and covers fiscal year to date activity. These figures are contract obligations, except where noted otherwise for award-value tables and expiring contracts. The award count and average award size describe current fiscal-year awards rather than lifetime contract values. Readers should treat the FY27 total as an interim snapshot compared with full-year totals from prior fiscal years.
